chat_template.jinja.source: GET /props chat_template on the installed server (eval/probes/fixtures/strata_chat_template.jinja), identical before and after the 2026-10-24 restart

preprocessing.tools: each tool rendered bare: an OpenAI {type, function} tool renders as its function object with every key in order (name, description, parameters and extras such as strict; verified on the live OpenCode bodies); an Anthropic tool renders as {name, description, parameters=input_schema}
preprocessing.tool_call_arguments: OpenAI string arguments are parsed as JSON to mappings before rendering (the template raises on non-empty string arguments)
preprocessing.reasoning: assistant reasoning is passed as reasoning_content (OpenAI field; Anthropic thinking blocks); preserve_thinking is never passed, so every earlier assistant turn keeps its reasoning
preprocessing.consecutive_tool_messages: left as separate tool messages; the template merges a run of tool messages into one user turn of <tool_response> blocks
preprocessing.effort: reasoning_effort passed through (high maps to xhigh in the template); effort none means enable_thinking=false and no reasoning_effort
preprocessing.enable_thinking: chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking or Anthropic thinking.type=disabled; passed only when given
